question: How many capability candidates, an Area with a predicate and an object stated in 10 or more independent articles, does the whole pool give?
one_change: count recurring predicate and object groups per depth-1 Area on the whole-pool assignments instead of a tenth of the rows

baseline.model: pilot on a tenth of the rows

prediction.metric: groups with 10 or more distinct articles
prediction.why: the slice of a tenth of the rows had 214 groups with 5 or more articles (equal to about 50 at full size) and 12180 groups in all; groups with 10 articles at full size show about one article in the slice, so the full count sits far above the 36 of the slice; wide on purpose because the slice does not show groups of 10 to 40 articles
